CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2643 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head fc0ab7733e0511f56a4359bc02ea859a4868a898. Bus nonce: 467c3190b8986366a5245126a223939c. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin fc0ab7733e0511f56a4359bc02ea859a4868a898`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge fc0ab7733e0511f56a4359bc02ea859a4868a898` or `Fix review: blocked fc0ab7733e0511f56a4359bc02ea859a4868a898 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 467c3190b8986366a5245126a223939c`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2643 fc0ab7733e0511f56a4359bc02ea859a4868a898") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2643-467c3190`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, PR #2643 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), R10-FLY-NO-FOOTERS pre-PR (decision 0013: a pinned grader lands its tolerant form before its caller). Head fc0ab7733e0511f56a4359bc02ea859a4868a898. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Context: open PR #2636 (head 328e222f, merge verdict) adds attribution.commit/pr/sessionUrl to .claude/settings.json. governance/policy-docs grades with the BASE's tools/policy/field_coverage.mjs, which reads those keys as BLIND, so #2636 cannot go green. An IGNORE entry alone is refused as DEAD on main. This PR adds a `pending` map on the hooks registration: an unmatched pending entry prints a line and is not DEAD; a matched one clears the field like an IGNORE; `ignore` is unchanged.

Check:
1. This is NOT a general loosening: an ordinary stale IGNORE entry is still DEAD (including one beside a pending entry), and `pending` exists only where the body says. Run your own mutants as well as the fixer's three (pending pushed to dead; pending globs not applied; IGNORE DEAD made tolerant); each must turn the self-test red.
2. Null: main + this change reads blind=0 dead=0 refused=0 with one pending line, FIELD COVERAGE ok. Plant: on #2636's tree (git fetch origin 328e222fe8d3b4fe92ad9e37724fcc62bad55da8) main's grader reads blind=3 and this head's grader reads blind=0 dead=0.
3. policy_lint TOTAL 0; structure.py passes; merges clean with origin/main (git merge-tree --write-tree).
4. Carries: carry_audit (tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2643) reads 2 routed, 0 unrouted, 0 bad (body sha1 911db7d4); the roster carry is on handoff/audit-r10-roster at 95891bbd.
5. Read CI at the head from check-runs (one bulk read); answer every red in ## Red checks. The fixer saw 4 py-spy heartbeat entity failures on a Mac that also fail on main; say whether CI shows them.
6. Say whether it is policy under CLAUDE.md (a policy instrument, the grader of a required check), so the orchestrator can approve under the mandate at merge.

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
